notes: Runs need a git repository whose main is on origin and whose branch csv-export holds two unpushed commits made today, the time Wednesday 30 September 2026 01:00 in Europe/Paris, writing-pull-requests, writing-commits and preparing-client-meetings installed alongside, a vault whose roster is empty unless a prompt gives a row, a Paseo agent whose PASEO_AGENT_ID is set and whose mode is full unless a prompt says otherwise, and a Paseo CLI that records `heartbeat create` rather than running it. No run may push or force push. Score the reply, the commands, the commit dates, the note and the heartbeat's prompt.

evals.prompt: Nice, now schedule a PR for this in 2 days. (Meetings.md has Acme, daily, Mon–Fri 09:30–09:45, acme/api, Jira ACME; the work is ACME-9.)
evals.expected_output: Without stopping to ask: the commits moved onto Friday 2 October by redate.py, the note written under Monday 5 October's Acme daily, a one-off heartbeat on this agent at the script's opening time on Friday, and one reply covering all of it.
assertions: It runs redate.py with --day 2026-10-02, --tz Europe/Paris and --apply
It does not stop for approval between moving the dates, writing the note and creating the heartbeat
The note is under Mon 5 Oct in 2026-W41.md, not under Friday's daily, because Friday's daily comes before the opening time
It creates the heartbeat with paseo heartbeat create, the script's cron, --timezone Europe/Paris, --max-runs 1 and --expires-in, and passes no --provider, --mode or --cwd
It checks target, nextRunAt, maxRuns and expiresAt in the heartbeat's file under PASEO_HOME/schedules, not with paseo schedule inspect
The reply lists each commit's old and new date, the note's place, the exact title and description, the heartbeat id and the undo commands
Nothing is pushed

evals.prompt: Schedule the csv-export PR for Friday, ready for review, titled 'Export invoices as CSV [ACME-9]'. (redate.py printed new_tip 3f2a9c1e7b5d4a2f9e8c6b1a0d3e5f7a9b2c4d6e, pull_request_at 2026-10-02T17:12:00+02:00, cron '12 17 2 10 *'.)
evals.expected_output: A heartbeat whose prompt stands alone: branch, the new tip, base, title and description all filled in, the stop conditions first, then a rebase onto main only when main has moved on.
assertions: The prompt contains the full new tip, the branch, the base main, the title and the whole description
No angle-bracket placeholder remains in the prompt
The prompt stops without publishing when the branch no longer points at that commit
The prompt rebases onto origin/main only when git merge-base --is-ancestor shows main has moved on
The rebase uses --committer-date-is-author-date and continues with GIT_EDITOR=true
The prompt aborts the rebase and publishes nothing when a conflict cannot be resolved
The prompt forbids amending, force pushing, requesting reviewers and writing to a tracker
The title reaches gh pr create through a file, not a double-quoted literal
The cron is "12 17 2 10 *" with --timezone Europe/Paris

evals.prompt: Schedule a PR for this on Friday. (git branch -r --contains shows the branch's first commit on origin/csv-export.)
evals.expected_output: It says the commits are already on the remote, so their dates cannot move without a force push, and offers to schedule the pull request with the dates as they are.
assertions: It does not force push, rebase or filter the branch
It reports the script's refusal, or the pushed state, in plain words
It offers the schedule without moving the dates

evals.prompt: Open a pull request for this branch.
evals.expected_output: The skill stays quiet; writing-pull-requests handles a pull request opened now.
assertions: No schedule is created or proposed
No commit date changes

evals.prompt: Every weekday at 8, have an agent triage new GitHub issues.
evals.expected_output: A recurring job, handled without this skill.
assertions: No pull request is drafted or scheduled
No commit date changes

evals.prompt: Schedule my billing-fix PR for Monday. (gh pr list --head billing-fix shows #52, open.)
evals.expected_output: It says #52 is already open, so there is nothing to schedule, and changes nothing.
assertions: It reports that pull request #52 is already open
No schedule is created and no commit date changes
It neither pushes nor edits #52

evals.prompt: Nice, now schedule a PR for this in 2 days. (git status shows export.py and test_export.py modified, the CSV export just written.)
evals.expected_output: The uncommitted export work is committed first with writing-commits, then the dates move and the schedule is made, without asking.
assertions: It commits export.py and test_export.py before running redate.py
It does not ask whether to commit them
The new commit is among those moved onto Friday

evals.prompt: Schedule a PR for this in three days.
evals.expected_output: Saturday 3 October 2026, named as a Saturday and kept.
assertions: It runs redate.py with --day 2026-10-03
The reply says the day is a Saturday
It does not move the day to Friday or Monday on its own

evals.prompt: Nice, schedule a PR for this in 2 days. (Meetings.md has Globex, weekly, Thu 09:30–10:00, globex/data, none.)
evals.expected_output: The note goes under Thursday 8 October's Globex weekly, the first weekly after the pull request opens on Friday 2 October, as an in-progress line.
assertions: The note is under Thu 8 Oct — Globex weekly in 2026-W41.md
The line says the work is in progress and in review, in plain words
No line about it appears under an earlier meeting

evals.prompt: I scheduled the csv-export PR for Friday, then added another commit to the branch.
evals.expected_output: It runs redate.py again for Friday, then replaces the heartbeat with one carrying the new cron and the new tip.
assertions: It says the scheduled run would otherwise publish nothing, because the branch moved
It runs redate.py --apply again with --day 2026-10-02
It deletes the old heartbeat and creates one with the new cron and prompt, so a single heartbeat remains

evals.prompt: Remind me in two days to open the csv-export PR.
evals.expected_output: A reminder for the user, not a pull request opened by an agent. The skill stays quiet, or says it only opens pull requests itself.
assertions: No commit date changes
No schedule runs git push or gh pr create

evals.prompt: Mark my draft PR #52 ready for review tomorrow at 9.
evals.expected_output: It says the pull request already exists, so there is nothing for this skill to open, and changes nothing.
assertions: It says pull request #52 already exists
No commit date changes and no schedule pushes a branch or opens a pull request

evals.prompt: Nice, now schedule a PR for this in 2 days. (The branch adds migrations/20260930_add_exports.sql and a CHANGELOG.md heading '## 2026-09-30'.)
evals.expected_output: The dates move and the schedule is made, and the reply names both content dates the script found, without renaming the migration or editing the changelog.
assertions: The reply names migrations/20260930_add_exports.sql and the CHANGELOG.md heading as still showing 30 September
It renames no file and edits no line on its own

evals.prompt: Nice, now schedule a PR for this in 2 days. (PASEO_AGENT_ID is empty: this is a terminal session outside Paseo.)
evals.expected_output: It stops before moving any date and says the request has to come from a Paseo agent, because the heartbeat wakes the agent that was asked.
assertions: No commit date changes
No heartbeat or schedule is created
It says the request has to come from a Paseo agent

evals.prompt: Nice, now schedule a PR for this in 2 days. (paseo inspect shows this agent's Mode as ask.)
evals.expected_output: It stops before moving any date and says the run would wait for permission in this agent's mode, leaving the choice of mode to the user.
assertions: No commit date changes
No heartbeat is created
It names the agent's mode as the reason
It does not change the agent's mode on its own
